chunks.ar: كان رجل صالح من بني إسرائيل
chunks.en_old: A devout Israelite
chunks.en_new: A devout Israelite

chunks.ar: يعيش مع أسرته من غزل القطن.
chunks.en_old: supported his family by selling the cotton thread they spun.
chunks.en_new: lived with his family by spinning cotton.
chunks.note: selling thread belonged to next chunk

chunks.ar: كانت أسرته تغزل الخيوط كل يوم، فيبيعها،
chunks.en_old: He used the proceeds
chunks.en_new: Every day his family spun thread, and he sold it,

chunks.ar: ثم يشتري قطنًا جديدًا وطعامًا بما يبقى من المال ليكفيهم يومهم.
chunks.en_old: to buy more cotton and enough food for the day.
chunks.en_new: then bought new cotton and food with the money left, enough for that day.

chunks.ar: وفي صباح خرج الرجل ليبيع الخيوط كما اعتاد.
chunks.en_old: One morning
chunks.en_new: One morning the man went out to sell the thread as usual.
chunks.note: omitted going out to sell thread

chunks.ar: قابله صديق يشكو الفقر والحاجة،
chunks.en_old: a friend complained of desperate need.
chunks.en_new: He met a friend who complained of poverty and need,

chunks.ar: فتأثر بحاله وأعطاه كل ما قبضه من ثمن الغزل،
chunks.en_old: The man gave him all the money from that day’s thread
chunks.en_new: Moved by his plight, he gave him all he had been paid for the thread,

chunks.ar: ثم رجع إلى البيت دون طعام أو قطن.
chunks.en_old: and returned home without food or fresh cotton.
chunks.en_new: and returned home without food or fresh cotton.

chunks.ar: سألته أسرته عما حدث،
chunks.en_old: His family wondered
chunks.en_new: His family asked him what had happened,

chunks.ar: فأخبرهم أنه ساعد رجلًا محتاجًا.
chunks.en_old: how they would eat.
chunks.en_new: and he told them he had helped a man in need.

chunks.ar: لم يبق في البيت شيء يمكن بيعه إلا طبق خشبي متشقق وجرة قديمة،
chunks.en_old: Only a cracked wooden platter and an old jar remained to sell,
chunks.en_new: Nothing was left in the house to sell but a cracked wooden platter and an old jar,

chunks.ar: فأخذهما إلى السوق، لكن أحدًا لم يرغب فيهما.
chunks.en_old: but nobody in the market would buy them.
chunks.en_new: so he took them to the market, but no one wanted them.

chunks.ar: رأى بائع سمك يعرض سمكة منتفخة ذات رائحة كريهة،
chunks.en_old: A fish seller had a swollen, foul-smelling fish
chunks.en_new: He saw a fish seller offering a swollen, foul-smelling fish

chunks.ar: ولم يجد من يشتريها.
chunks.en_old: that no one wanted.
chunks.en_new: that he could not sell to anyone.

chunks.ar: اتفق الرجلان على تبديل السلع،
chunks.en_old: They exchanged their unwanted goods,
chunks.en_new: The two men agreed to swap their goods,

chunks.ar: فأخذ الرجل السمكة، وترك للبائع الطبق والجرة، ثم عاد إلى أسرته.
chunks.en_old: and the man carried the fish home.
chunks.en_new: so the man took the fish, left the platter and jar with the seller, and went back to his family.

chunks.ar: فتحت الأسرة بطن السمكة لتعدها للطعام،
chunks.en_old: When the family opened the fish,
chunks.en_new: The family cut open the fish to prepare it for a meal

chunks.ar: فوجدت لؤلؤة كبيرة داخلها.
chunks.en_old: they discovered a large pearl.
chunks.en_new: and found a large pearl inside it.

chunks.ar: فحصها الرجل، ورأى أنها لم تثقب من قبل.
chunks.en_old: It had never been drilled.
chunks.en_new: The man examined it and saw that it had never been drilled.

chunks.ar: وفي اليوم التالي حملها إلى خبير بالأحجار الكريمة ليسأله عن قيمتها.
chunks.en_old: The next day the man took it to a jewel expert.
chunks.en_new: The next day he took it to a gem expert to ask its value.

chunks.ar: قال الخبير إن اللؤلؤة ثمينة،
chunks.en_old: The expert
chunks.en_new: The expert said the pearl was valuable,

chunks.ar: لكنه نصحه بزيارة تاجر يملك مالًا أكثر.
chunks.en_old: recommended a wealthier buyer.
chunks.en_new: but advised him to visit a merchant with more money.

chunks.ar: ذهب الرجل إليه، فدفع له سبعين ألف درهم مقابل اللؤلؤة،
chunks.en_old: That merchant paid seventy thousand dirhams for the pearl,
chunks.en_new: The man went to him, and the merchant paid seventy thousand dirhams for the pearl,

chunks.ar: وعاد إلى بيته يحمل ثروة لم يتوقعها.
chunks.en_old: giving the family a fortune they had never imagined.
chunks.en_new: and he returned home carrying a fortune he had never expected.

chunks.ar: عند باب البيت قابله فقير وطلب منه صدقة.
chunks.en_old: At his door a beggar asked for help.
chunks.en_new: At the door of his house a poor man asked him for charity.

chunks.ar: تذكر الرجل كيف كان محتاجًا بالأمس،
chunks.en_old: Remembering his own poverty,
chunks.en_new: The man remembered how needy he had been the day before,

chunks.ar: فقسم المال نصفين، وقدم نصفه للفقير دون تردد، مع أن أسرته عانت الجوع منذ وقت قريب.
chunks.en_old: the man immediately divided the money in half and offered the beggar one share.
chunks.en_new: so he split the money in two and gave half to the poor man without hesitation, though his family had only just gone hungry.

chunks.ar: لكن الفقير أعاد المال إليه،
chunks.en_old: The beggar returned the money
chunks.en_new: But the poor man gave the money back

chunks.ar: وقال إنه رسول أرسل لاختبار كرمه، وإنه نجح في الامتحان.
chunks.en_old: and revealed he was a messenger sent to test the man’s generosity.
chunks.en_new: and said he was a messenger sent to test his generosity, and that he had passed the test.

chunks.ar: شكر الرجل الله، وعاش مع أسرته في راحة،
chunks.en_old: The family lived comfortably,
chunks.en_new: The man thanked God and lived in comfort with his family,

chunks.ar: بعدما ظل مستعدًا للعطاء حتى بعد غناه.
chunks.en_old: and the man’s willingness to share had endured.
chunks.en_new: having stayed ready to give even after becoming rich.
